lines.zh: 我在水里摆尾，泥底被我搅浑。
lines.en: I beat my tail; the muddy bottom clouds.

lines.zh: 牙齿从唇边露出来，合不上。
lines.en: My teeth show past my lip and will not close.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸巡，水面划出一道。
lines.en: I patrol the bank, cutting a line in the water.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道把我引向下游。
lines.en: The smell of rot draws me downstream.

lines.zh: 我的鳍上有一层灰白的东西。
lines.en: A grey film coats my fins.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水色变暗。
lines.en: The water darkens where I swim.
I skim the stones on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 有东西落水，我立刻转过去。
lines.en: Something hits the water; I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，不激起波纹。
lines.en: I close in without raising a ripple.
I circle the smell of blood.
The shoal breaks apart; none dare block me.
I wait at the edge of the weeds.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I hang in the water, gills working.

lines.zh: 嘴还张着，牙一直露在外面。
lines.en: My mouth stays open; teeth always show.
My tail fin muddies the water.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游到我的嘴边。
lines.en: A small fish swims right up to my mouth.
I hang among the weeds, waiting for blood.
The light patch on the water keeps shifting.

lines.zh: 我从水里抬起头，只露出眼。
lines.en: I lift my head from the water; only my eyes show.
Are you washing your hands on the bank?
I stop an inch from the bank.
I raise my head and look at you.
My teeth look black in the sun.
I shut my mouth and sink.
Only a ring remains on the surface.
Your hand reaches the water's edge.
They look very slow in the water.

lines.zh: 腐化的味道，从我鳃里出来。
lines.en: The smell of corruption leaves my gills.

lines.zh: 腐肉翻起来，我又沉下去。
lines.en: Rotten flesh turns up as I sink back down.
This time I will not back off.

lines.zh: 腐水涌进伤口，我咬得更凶。
lines.en: Corruption floods the wound, and I bite harder.

lines.zh: 鳞片裂开，血腥味让我发狂。
lines.en: My scales split, and the smell of blood drives me wild.

lines.zh: 这一击只让我想起饥饿。
lines.en: That blow only reminds me of hunger.

lines.zh: 血味一散开，我立刻窜过去。
lines.en: Blood spreads; I dart at once.

lines.zh: 我咬住那块东西，甩了甩头。
lines.en: I bite it and shake my head.
The blood in the water excites me.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔远，我追过去。
lines.en: You throw it far; I chase.

lines.zh: 你下水的时候，我撞了你的腿。
lines.en: When you enter the water, I ram your leg.
I slide off and come back.
I cannot see you in the murk.
But I know where you are.

lines.zh: 转了一圈，又绕回你面前。
lines.en: One turn, and I'm in front of you again.

lines.zh: 水浑的时候我才做这些。
lines.en: I do this when the water is murky.
The eggs will sink among the weeds.
It is bigger than my mouth.

lines.zh: 我在石头下面藏了东西。
lines.en: I have hidden something under a stone.

lines.zh: 诱饵一落水，我就咬住不松口。
lines.en: The moment bait hits the water, I bite and never let go.
A new taste enters the water.
This is bigger than a fish.

lines.zh: 水花很小，我的动作很轻。
lines.en: Barely a splash; I move quietly.
I am looking for somewhere to bite.
Its legs are slow in the water.

lines.zh: 腐化的牙，一排排换过了。
lines.en: My corrupted teeth have grown back twice.

lines.zh: 我这口牙，被腐化磨尖了。
我咬住它的腿，往水里拖。
lines.en: I bite its leg and drag it into the water.

lines.zh: 我把牙在它身上转了半圈。
lines.en: I twist my teeth half a turn.

lines.zh: 它踢我，我被踢开又回来。
lines.en: It kicks; I am thrown off and return.
I ram the back of its knee.
I bite off a small piece.
My teeth are a row of little knives.
I let go and back off.
Someone on the bank steps back.
I turn to look at them.
The weeds part on both sides of me.

lines.zh: 血腥味把我从深处叫醒。
lines.en: The smell of blood wakes me from the deep.
Splashes follow me all the way.
It stays open a long while.

lines.zh: 水面在烧，我的鳍缩起来。
lines.en: The surface burns; my fins curl.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔进浅水，磕在石头上。
lines.en: I fall into shallow water and strike stone.

lines.zh: 水就是我的家，这点淹不到我。
lines.en: Water is my home; this cannot drown me.

lines.zh: 炸起的水柱把我甩出去。
lines.en: The blast throws me up in a column of water.

lines.zh: 那东西射穿水面，扎进我的背。
lines.en: It pierces the water and buries in my back.
A numbness runs from my gills to my tail.
Hungry enough to bite the weeds.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水过来，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning comes through the water and I lock up.

lines.zh: 水里没有底了，我往下沉。
lines.en: The water has no floor; I sink.
